description: This file defines the LoginService class in the OrangeHRM Authentication System, providing methods for logging user login activities, including standard and OIDC logins, and managing login log data access.

classes.name: LoginService
classes.description: Service class handling user login logging, supporting both standard and OIDC login mechanisms, utilizing dependency injection and DAO patterns.

methods.name: getLoginLogDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LoginLogDao instance for database operations related to login logs.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Creates and saves a login log entry for a user based on provided credentials.

methods.name: addOIDCLogin
methods.description: Creates and saves a login log entry for a user authenticated via OIDC.
